subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers review/adopt the open external fork PR, replace it with a narrow upstream PR, or keep waiting on the contributor?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-proven, but the active candidate fix is outside the target repository with maintainer edits disabled, so automation should not queue a duplicate without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: If the patch still fits current main, review or adopt it into openclaw/openclaw so this issue can close after merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrow upstream PR
options.body: If the fork branch is not usable, create a focused upstream PR that only normalizes the shared label helper and adds regression coverage.

options.title: Wait on the contributor
options.body: Keep this issue open and leave the fork PR as the active candidate if maintainers want the contributor to refresh it first.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: If the patch still fits current main, review or adopt it into openclaw/openclaw so this issue can close after merge.
